R1D-duck-drive-0002.name: Unnamed wetland 940 m N of Stafford Lake
R1D-duck-drive-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 20.7 ha, 50 m from the road.
About 16 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Stafford River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 104 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

seasonRows.notes: District 1. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6. Date for 2026 to 2027, worked out from the federal wording and matched to the BC synopsis (page 21 Region 1, page 28 Region 2). It moves each year.

plan: Drive: from City of Campbell River, about 112 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.791, -125.44587, pull off on Blk 229 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 60 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-15, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1D-duck-drive-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 1-15: about 2,613 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.31 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
